name: confluence
description: Search and read Confluence pages across one or two instances, optionally mirroring them to Markdown for a local RAG knowledge base.

base_url.title: Confluence base URL
base_url.description: e.g. https://confluence.internal.example.com - no trailing slash. REQUIRED. This is the DEFAULT server: prompts that do not name a server use it.

name.title: Name for this Confluence server
name.description: Optional, e.g. Green. Only needed if you configure a second server below - it is how a prompt picks between them. Defaults to 'Primary'.

base_url_2.title: Second Confluence base URL
base_url_2.description: Optional. Leave blank if you only have one Confluence. If set, it also needs its own token in the CONFLUENCE_TOKEN_2 environment variable.

name_2.title: Name for the second Confluence server
name_2.description: Optional, e.g. Blue. Say it in a prompt ('...on Blue') to query the second server. Defaults to 'Secondary'.

kb_dir.title: Knowledge-base folder
kb_dir.description: Every page read is also saved as Markdown here (shared by both servers), for the knowledge-base plugin to index. Keep it inside that plugin's documents folder (C:\Eva\knowledge) or the mirrors are never indexed. Enter 'off' to disable mirroring, after which this server writes no local file at all.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
